chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

It is disliked for a man to approach a woman while he has had a nocturnal emission, until he performs ghusl (ritual bath) from the emission that he saw. If he does so and the child is born mentally disordered, then he should blame none but himself.

key_terms.يَغْشَى: to approach sexually or have intercourse

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to have intercourse before performing ghusl after a wet dream?
ai.summary: This hadith states that it is disliked for a man to have intercourse after a nocturnal emission before performing ghusl (ritual bath). It presents this as part of sexual etiquette and ritual purity, while warning of harmful consequences for ignoring it.
